drivers.title: Should Government Officials Be Banned From Prediction Markets? House Oversight Says Maybe
drivers.detail: A House Oversight staff memorandum, citing suspicious trades by officials, military personnel and clearance holders, recommends Congress weigh new limits on federal personnel betting on platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket. (Decrypt, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Wake Up After 16 Years, Moving $6.9 Million
drivers.detail: Two Bitcoin mining rewards from September 2010 moved minutes apart. The coins are worth nearly 1.15 million times their original market value. (Decrypt, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years
drivers.detail: The producer price index was expected to increase 0.4% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus. (CNBC, Globe and Mail are covering it.)

drivers.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
drivers.detail: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus. (CoinDesk.)

drivers.title: Could a Former Nvidia Executive Replace Jensen Huang? Arm’s Rene Haas Emerges as Candidate
drivers.detail: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's chief executive as it searches for a replacement for Jensen Huang, while some employees are pushing to bring the chipmaker's founder back as CEO. (Decrypt.)
